what: Today's leg on the old material data: cad/leg_studies.py at d794466 (the revision the v0.6.0 leg record was made at) under cad-agent v0.4.2 (2ad4269), on the same host, mesher and virtualenv as the v0.6.0 run. It separates what the material change did from what the design changes since the committed v0.4.2 record did (PR 134's hip frame and knee). compare.py reads it as 'v0.4.2 today'.
host: recording mechanical compute host: aarch64, conda-forge gmsh 4.15.2

toolkit.how: on PYTHONPATH over the v0.6.0 run's virtualenv
